notes.subject: Elohim
notes.rationale: Elohim long pes bilong king (KJV/ASV 'O God') o possessiv 'tron bilong Elohim' i bin givim (JPS) — mipela bihainim pes: 'Tron bilong yu, Elohim'.

notes.subject: שבט…שבט
notes.rationale: Hibru i ripitim שבט tupela taim — klia pasin bilong raunem tok; Tpi i ripitim 'stik bilong bosim' wankain.

notes.subject: king
notes.rationale: Tok i toktok stret long king long nem namba tu (ata).

translation: Tron bilong yu, Elohim, i stap long olgeta taim, wantaim olgeta; stik bilong bosim bilong stret i stik bilong bosim bilong kingdom bilong yu.
